Nina Park: Heads-up — new onboarding examples (vite + workers) started failing after our recent package.json exports change. Browser shows: 'Failed to resolve module specifier "@redwood/inference"'. Quick repro: clone sample-apps/onboard-vite, npm install, npm run dev.

Ethan Zhou: I can repro with wrangler and esbuild. The exports map only provides import/require for the package root; some bundlers/edge resolvers ignore the import conditional and fall back incorrectly.

Maya R.: Also seeing editor noise — VSCode: 'Could not find a declaration file for module "@redwood/inference"'. We removed top-level "types" in the last cleanup which broke DX for many consumers.

Nina Park: Temporary workaround added to the sample readme: alias to dist/esm/index.mjs in vite config. Not acceptable long term.

Ethan Zhou: Minimal package.json patch that should fix most consumers: add top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts", keep "module" and "main" fields, and expand exports to include a conservative default and explicit helper subpaths (./auth, ./retry). Example:
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
"exports": {"." : {"types":"./dist/index.d.ts","import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","default":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs"}, "./auth": {"import":"./dist/esm/auth.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/auth.cjs"}, "./package.json":"./package.json"}

Maya R.: We also discovered RetryableAuth isn't present in the esm entry because rollup marked auth as external. Short-term we can emit auth.mjs and wire an explicit ./auth export. Long-term, include auth in the main esm rollup entry so consumers don't need deep imports.

ci-bot: CI #1012 sample-apps/onboard-vite FAILED. Excerpt: 'Could not resolve "@redwood/inference" (vite)'. Full logs: https://ci.internal/1012 (internal).

Nina Park: Action items:
- Ethan: open a patch PR (v0.14.x) to add types/main/module and the exports patch above.
- Maya: update rollup to either include auth in esm entry or emit auth.mjs and d.ts. Add a small smoke test that bundles a worker.
- Me: keep the temporary alias snippet in quickstart readme and remove once patch is published.

Ethan Zhou: Will open the PR and ping here. Hoping to push a patch today to stop onboarding regressions. :shipit:
